The front paws are tucked against the chest, and the hind legs are planted on a rock or ground surface obscured by grass.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small, round, and dark, consistent with the taxonomy.
The ears are visible on the top corners of the head; they are short and appear rounded, matching the description.

The visible hind legs are short relative to the body length. The forelimbs are tucked but appear proportionally short.
